<!-- Generated by ModuleDocsGenerator from the annotations of org.hortonmachine.modules.SurfaceInterpolator: do not edit, change the annotations and regenerate. -->

Interpolates the values of a vector of points onto the grid of a raster, with Thin Plate Splines or Inverse Distance Weighting: each cell is computed from the points within the buffer distance around it.

**Toolbox folder:** Raster Processing<br>
**Status:** Draft<br>
**Keywords:** Interpolation, Raster, Points, Spline, IDW<br>
**Authors:** Jan Jezek, Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.SurfaceInterpolator`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inVector` | vector file |  |  | The vector of the points to interpolate. |
| `inGrid` | raster file |  |  | The raster whose grid, extent and cell size, the output takes. |
| `inMask` | raster file |  |  | An optional raster: the values are computed only where it has values. |
| `fCat` | String |  |  | The field of the points with the values to interpolate. |
| `pMode` | String |  | `TPS` | The interpolation: TPS (Thin Plate Splines), smooth, or IDW (Inverse Distance Weighting), more robust with dense points. Allowed values: `TPS`, `IDW`. |
| `pBuffer` | double | m | `4.0` | The distance around each cell within which the points are used. |
| `pMaxThreads` | int |  | number of processors | Max threads to use. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outRaster` | output file |  | The interpolated raster. |
